name: A-One Steels India Limited
about: A-One Steels India Limited engages in manufacturing and trading of steel products in India. The company offers direct reduced iron, sponge iron that includes TMT bars, hot rolled coils, cold rolled coils, mild steel billets, hot rolled pipes, GP pipes, and cold rolled pipes; galvanized tubes and pipes; and met coke and ferro alloys. It also distributes industrial products, such as met coke, MS billets, and ferro alloys. It serves industries and infrastructure segments, including construction and infrastructure projects, power plants, dams, airports, bridges, flyovers, stadiums, highways, underground structures, marine structures, industrial structures, and high-rise residential buildings. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Bengaluru, India.
